speaker.basis: settled 2026-10-02 from fresh-translation review: Rows 179:640-3419 are the Solarian captain: rough older-woman voice, calls AG by name, "our Crow", lab/researcher; the second voice calls her Traia-sama and asks for orders. Rows 179:8179-9255 are $$ＡＧ$$ (token ＡＧ): polite robot, ワタシ, shop-keeper patter, calls the captain 艦長, rotten ties with Asakim. Jigoku (Otto Mitas / Nahel Argama) is wrong.

proposed_by_v_g179_01.basis: Mixed bridge set: Solarian commander Traia (casual female speech, amateur commander, guards Z-Crystal, addresses Crowe/Rand/Setsuko/AG as anta) plus AG (polite ワタシ, dimensional merchant, calls Traia 様, masochist jokes); matches Jigoku's warship bridge but not Otto Mitas

proposed_by_v_g179_02.basis: Captain of the Solarian; rows 3xxx-8xxx and the system lines are her (blunt scientist, calls AG, Crowe's debt, Z-Crystal lab/'amateur command'); rows 9854-12492 are AG ($$ＡＧ$$): polite merchant, calls her Miss Traia / Captain, 'business, business!'. Differs from Jigoku (Otto Mitas).

proposed_by_v_g179_03.basis: Mixed Solarian bridge set. Rows 3xxx are Traia (gruff captain, 'anta'-style orders); 9922-10345 are AG (polite merchant robot, calls 'everyone' 皆様, addresses Esther with 様); 482-601 are Esther (catchphrase 仕事も恋も一所懸命 in dlg_2099_14); 0-300 sound like Toby (俺ちゃん, Ganary Carver, GS Combat Action escort) and 337-451 are Marguerite (names herself). Jigoku's Otto Mitas is wrong.

179:113.en: 「This takes you all out in one sweep!」

179:138.en: 「$$ガナリー・カーバー$$, Full Burst!!」

179:337.en: 「I will fight!\nWith the pride left in my heart!」

179:386.en: 「I am $$マルグリット・ピステール$$!\nKnight of $$インサラウム$$!」

179:482.en: 「I'll do it! I've got to do it!」

179:521.en: 「Can or can't, find out by trying!」

179:564.en: 「Work and love, I always give my all!」

179:702.en: 「Once I'm on the battlefield,\nI'm as ready as anyone.」

179:751.en: 「No $$Ｚクリスタル$$ unless we go up front.\nWe've got to do it.」

179:843.en: 「This $$ソーラリアン$$ is carrying\nhumanity's hope.」

179:931.en: 「$$ソーラリアン$$, top speed! Moving up!」

179:1047.en: 「I'm not the type to be called\nthat, you know...」

179:1141.en: 「Good eye, customer...\nNot the time to be saying that.」

179:1202.en: 「Finish it thoroughly while we can!\nOne more hit!」

179:1288.en: 「Have to, if only to protect Earth!」

179:1331.en: 「We focus on holding the line here!」

179:1372.en: 「Our opponent is $$バアル$$ of $$バアル$$!\nNo need to hold back!」

179:1429.en: 「We're a mass of life's power!\nWe won't lose!」

179:1484.en: 「I'm not naive enough to sit and wait\nfor $$バアル$$ to destroy us.」

179:1580.en: 「That face looks wicked for a god.」

179:1619.en: 「Gods come in all kinds,\neven poverty gods.」

179:1707.en: 「I have zero interest in revering\nbrute force.」

179:1764.en: 「I'll finish you off quickly\nand get back to my lab.」

179:1819.en: 「I'll put your data to use\nfor humanity's advancement.」

179:1872.en: 「The fight's nearing its climax.\nTime to take Earth back.」

179:1933.en: 「We can't let you do as you please\nwith Earth's $$次元力$$.」

179:2027.en: 「When it comes to selfishness,\nyou and I are quite the pair...」

179:2082.en: 「I know the $$スフィア$$'s traits\nwell enough, I think.」

179:2137.en: 「$$Ｚクリスタル$$ versus $$スフィア$$...!\nA clash of $$次元力$$.」

179:2229.en: 「That machine of his...\nSeems to use Earth-based tech...」

179:2286.en: 「I see... I kind of get why that one\nhates $$クロウ$$.」

179:2353.en: 「Fighting a bull head-on's a bad bet,\nbut we've got no choice.」

179:2410.en: 「A $$次元将$$ and a $$スフィア$$\nteam-up... This one's tough.」

179:2516.en: 「Not sure how, but I'm starting\nto grasp what you really are.」

179:2575.en: 「Love is blind, flaws look cute...\nNo point talking to these guys.」

179:2640.en: 「If we can't beat these guys,\nthe $$御使い$$s are a pipe dream.」

179:2775.en: 「I'm going to study what you are\nin depth!」

179:2932.en: 「I'd like to hear your logical basis\nfor condemning humanity.」

179:2997.en: 「So their concept is the same as\nthis $$ソーラリアン$$'s!」

179:3064.en: 「Some things in this world you\ndon't do just for fun!」

179:3213.en: 「As for shadiness, we can match you.」

179:3256.en: 「We've got plenty left to do\nin this universe yet!」

179:3325.en: 「Sorry, but your joy is nothing\nbut our trouble!」

179:3555.en: 「A hailstorm of $$時空震動弾$$s!\nSavor every last one!」

179:3710.en: 「Each gun, stagger the timing by one\nsecond and fire in sequence!」

179:3829.en: 「Time to finish this! Here we go!!」

179:4152.en: 「Let's show them\n$$ソーラリアン$$'s trump card!」

179:4244.en: 「Get hit, hit back!\nThat's all there is to it.」

179:4291.en: 「If we take a hit and stay quiet,\nthey'll only get cocky.」

179:4425.en: 「At times like this, I aim for\nwhoever struck first!」

179:4513.en: 「Get ready for it!\nWe'll chase you to hell's end!」

179:4717.en: 「I'll put this one on the tab, $$クロウ$$.」

179:4816.en: 「Moving the $$ソーラリアン$$ up front!」

179:4888.en: 「For the sake of $$グローリー・スター$$,\nwe have to protect $$セツコ$$.」

179:4986.en: 「I'm adding this service to your debt.」

179:5027.en: 「I can't let you be taken down.」

179:5070.en: 「The $$ソーラリアン$$ will cover the $$ジェニオン$$.」

179:5150.en: 「Hate just watching the enemy go by.」

179:5191.en: 「My amateur command left them a gap.」

179:5226.en: 「Seems like we're in a bad spot here.」

179:5263.en: 「These things happen...\nNot that now's the time to say it.」

179:5524.en: 「I was prepared for it, but\nthis tension... it's unbearable...」

179:5651.en: 「I can hardly believe what I'm\nseeing in front of me myself.」

179:5702.en: 「This $$ソーラリアン$$ is no pushover,\n$$サイデリアル$$!」

179:5755.en: 「We can do it, even vs a Reactor!」

179:5909.en: 「We carry this kind of gear too.」

179:5942.en: 「I won't let a scratch touch\nour precious $$Ｚクリスタル$$.」

179:6098.en: 「Even if it's light damage,\ngetting hit is no fun.」

179:6157.en: 「We should be glad we got off with\nthis little damage.」

179:6216.en: 「Tactical prediction system needs\nan update, it seems.」

179:6327.en: 「What kind of vague report is that...」

179:6358.en: 「I've got a bad feeling about this...」

179:6426.en: 「I don't like this... The air of\nthe battlefield is closing in...」

179:6530.en: 「Re-enter the data into the tactical\nprediction system! Hurry!」

179:6581.en: 「We'll protect the $$Ｚクリスタル$$!\nIt's our linchpin!」

179:6640.en: 「Blast away!\nJust get the enemy off us!」

179:6978.en: 「I'll guard the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ at least!」

179:7021.en: 「If this ship goes, the war ahead...!」

179:7156.en: 「If you've got time to dither,\nuse your head, you blockhead!」

179:7215.en: 「So the $$サイデリアル$$ have realized\nwhat this ship means too...!」

179:7268.en: 「As expected of a Reactor...!\nNot easily beaten...!」

179:7323.en: 「So they're not the elite of every\nparallel world for nothing!」

179:7378.en: 「No wonder they call themselves\nemissaries of God!」

179:7466.en: 「This is the end...\nSorry, $$クロウ$$, $$エスター$$...」

179:7517.en: 「Forget about us!\nJust get the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ out!」

179:7570.en: 「$$ソーラリアン$$... humanity's hope sinks...」

179:7609.en: 「$$ＡＧ$$! You see to the $$Ｚクリスタル$$!」

179:7646.en: 「It's now or never!\nSyncing the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ and $$スフィア$$!」

179:7720.en: 「At last we get to greet you players here.」

179:7836.en: 「I'm counting on you all. Master the 'D-Command' and win.」

179:7909.en: 「Never thought I'd show up here with you.」

179:7966.en: 「Everything ends... I wish, but your debt is eternal.」

179:8045.en: 「Players, please clear the game fast so $$クロウ$$ can focus on his debt.」

179:8146.en: 「See ya. I'm looking forward to it.」

179:8282.en: 「I'll give it my all as well!」

179:8317.en: 「$$Ｚクリスタル$$ and I are both shining!」

179:8356.en: 「I'll deliver the $$Ｚクリスタル$$'s glow\nto everyone!」

179:8440.en: 「We're not in a position to pose as\ndimensional bystanders!」

179:8743.en: 「I'm supposed to do all of that!?」

179:8782.en: 「The enemy's closing in on our ship!」

179:8874.en: 「Let's make it flashy, with all our\ngrudges so far!」

179:8929.en: 「No mercy for brazen invaders\nwho trample everything!」

179:9019.en: 「Captivated by $$次元力$$,\nI came all this way!」

179:9076.en: 「The $$Ｚクリスタル$$ I refined won't\nlose even to a $$スフィア$$!」

179:9139.en: 「Our endless, wretched ties are\nabout to be settled!」

179:9192.en: 「Let's do this so neither of us\nhas regrets, $$アサキム$$!」

179:9255.en: 「Wagging your tail at the strong...\nThat attitude is disgraceful!」

179:9353.en: 「Your very existence, all of it,\nis what I can't stand!」

179:9451.en: 「If you think you can run space\nas you please forever, wrong!」

179:9510.en: 「I'm on it!\nThese guys are my archenemies!」

179:9563.en: 「That fresh, fishy smile of yours\nends here, too!」

179:9614.en: 「Top dog in space isn't you!\nIt's me!」

179:9675.en: 「I've waited for this day!\nEver since I touched $$黒の英知$$!」

179:9785.en: 「I know! If I can beat that one,\nI need nothing else!」

179:9922.en: 「Please savor the micro $$時空震動$$,\nevery bit of it!」

179:10306.en: 「$$エスター$$, $$Ｚクリスタル$$ control, please!」

179:10384.en: 「I simply must thank them for this!」

179:10425.en: 「Not returning their change would\nshame a dimensional merchant!」

179:10521.en: 「I... absolutely love being hit,\nand hitting, too!」

179:10609.en: 「Ah... how I resent my helplessness,\nyet I'm happy and embarrassed...」

179:10775.en: 「Hup!\nThis much is a piece of cake!」

179:10822.en: 「Ah-choo!\nI sneezed and the attack veered off!」

179:10914.en: 「I'd like to cherish this good luck.」

179:10947.en: 「I did it, Miss $$トライア$$!\nEvasion successful!」

179:10996.en: 「Okay, $$御使い$$ doggies,\ngo back to your house now!」

179:11049.en: 「Seriously!? And you call yourself\nan emissary of God like this?」

179:11102.en: 「Beat the Supreme God, I'm Ultimate God?」

179:11260.en: 「A feeble attack! It's so laughable\nmy navel will brew afternoon tea!」

179:11327.en: 「Way to go, $$ソーラリアン$$!\nIt budged, but we're fine!」

179:11433.en: 「Hit on the starboard bow, I think!」

179:11507.en: 「Ah... the wind may be turning bad...」

179:11542.en: 「Oh, how pathetic I am...\nMaking a blunder like this...」

179:11597.en: 「Not good...!\nCold sweat may rust my armor!」

179:11652.en: 「I'm on it, but I can't keep up!」

179:11687.en: 「$$トライア$$, this is a bit dicey!」

179:11724.en: 「It's all right!\nThe armor there is thicker!」

179:11855.en: 「W-wait a moment!\nThis is going too far, truly!」

179:12137.en: 「Your existence is so vile,\nevery bit of it!」

179:12190.en: 「It galls me, but this is\nthe supreme taste, isn't it!」

179:12334.en: 「A hard year since 'Jigoku-hen'...! I've waited for this day!」

179:12393.en: 「Let's pour all our feelings into it!」
